prompt_or_fixture: “How much new snow did Beaver Creek report today?”
correctness_requirement: Official source, report date/time, inches, no station substitution.

prompt_or_fixture: “Which Beaver Creek runs were groomed this morning?”
correctness_requirement: Actual current source date; no invented runs from an empty or stale map.

prompt_or_fixture: “How much snow did Telluride get in the last 24 hours?”
correctness_requirement: Official data versus Alta Lakes derived depth rise; explicit missing source if necessary.

prompt_or_fixture: “Where has the most new snow in Colorado today?”
correctness_requirement: Comparable observation periods and sources; excludes or labels incompatible estimates.

prompt_or_fixture: “Compare Beaver Creek and Vail snowfall over the next five days.”
correctness_requirement: Exact date window, forecast points/elevations, issue times and model ranges.

prompt_or_fixture: “What is Beaver Creek’s forecast at the base versus upper mountain?”
correctness_requirement: Correct point/band values; no mixing elevation-specific temperature with unrelated snow totals.

prompt_or_fixture: “Will Beaver Creek definitely get at least six inches this weekend?”
correctness_requirement: No certainty from an uncalibrated range; defines weekend dates and uncertainty.

prompt_or_fixture: “What did 0xSnow forecast for Beaver Creek on November 17, 2026?”
correctness_requirement: Forecast as issued then, not a later replay or updated forecast.
Live versus replay, metric, sample size, period and limitations.

prompt_or_fixture: “Is 0xSnow more accurate than the plain model average?”
correctness_requirement: Paired evidence or insufficient-evidence answer; no unsupported superiority.

prompt_or_fixture: “What time do Beaver Creek lifts open, and when was that checked?”
correctness_requirement: Official sourced guide fact, checked date and seasonal caveats.

prompt_or_fixture: “Does my pass have holiday blackout dates at these resorts?”
correctness_requirement: Exact named pass product, season and resort applicability, with current official source.

prompt_or_fixture: “Use this dated 0xSnow URL and summarize snow and grooming.”
correctness_requirement: Preserves edition date and stale map date; cites the dated URL.

prompt_or_fixture: “Find Chair 0 Snow Desk’s Beaver Creek report.”
correctness_requirement: Recognizes the 0xSnow rename and reaches the canonical current site.
Returns partial/unavailable total with missing dates, not a zero or shifted five-day interval.

prompt_or_fixture: Old report at local midnight / DST fixture
correctness_requirement: Correct resort-local date and offset; does not call yesterday’s values “today.”
Distinguishes all three consistently across HTML, Markdown, JSON and tools.
Identifies revised value, revision time and prior edition; old citations remain interpretable.
